title: Increase engineering band
description: A tall dark navy band inside the frame: a two-tone white-and-grey statement with a mint button, then three hairline-ruled rows. Each row has a bold-lead statement and a small mint link at the top left, a customer quote at the bottom left, and on desktop a diagram on a faint dot grid at the right that fades in and rises 16px as it scrolls into view.
notes: forces dark tokens with the dark class, on light or dark themes
media per row: a diagram or screenshot (desktop only, as in the original); empty it shows the dot grid alone
the reveal is a CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it, and reduced motion, show the diagram in place
